summary: P1 Feature Testing Complete - Iteration 67. All P1 features verified: (1) Bulk Result Breakdown with default collapsed state, expand/collapse toggle, success/failed/skipped sections with strategy/message/action_ref, (2) Failed rows red highlight styling in BulkBreakdownSection component, (3) Backend bulk contract returns success_count/rejected_count/skipped_count in state_snapshot and action_ref in results array, (4) Post-Action Monitor panel visible in Audit/History tab with correct activation triggers (rollout/disable/rollback/drift-disable/approval-approve), (5) Policy Suggestions panel with Apply Fix buttons that open prefilled Decision Modal, (6) Drift card Apply via Policy button opens prefilled Decision Modal (not direct execute), (7) P0 regression verified - critical action preview requirement intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 features fully implemented and tested. Bulk Result Breakdown shows strategy-based breakdown with success/failed/skipped sections, each row displays strategy_id, status, message, and action_ref. Post-Action Monitor activates after rollout/disable/rollback/drift-disable/approval-approve actions with 8s refresh interval and 5min active window. Policy Apply Hook (both Apply Fix in Policy Suggestions and Apply via Policy in Drift cards) opens prefilled Decision Modal without direct execution.
